subject: general
question: In February 2023, who was appointed as the new Governor of Himachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shiv Pratap Shukla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Shiv Pratap Shukla was appointed as the Governor of Himachal Pradesh in February 2023.
 
• He succeeded Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar, the former Governor of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• Shukla has served as a Member of Parliament in the Rajya Sabha representing the state of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• He is a senior leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and has held various key positions in the party and government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Role of a Governor**

 
 
• The Governor is the constitutional head of each of the states in India.
 
• They are appointed by the President of India for a term of five years.
 
• The Governor acts on the advice of the Council of Ministers headed by the Chief Minister.
 
• The Governor has the power to summon, prorogue, and dissolve the state legislature.
 
 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh**
 
 
• Himachal Pradesh is located in the northern part of India.
 
• The state is known for its scenic beauty, including the Himalayan mountains.
 
• It was granted statehood on 25th January 1971.
 
• The capital of Himachal Pradesh is Shimla, and its largest city is also Shimla.
 
 
 
• **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**
 
 
• The BJP is one of the two major political parties in India, along with the Indian National Congress.
 
• It was founded in 1980 by members of the Bharatiya Jana Sangh.
 
• The party advocates for a policy of integral humanism, which was first formulated by Deendayal Upadhyaya.
 
• The BJP has been the ruling party in India since 2014 under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
